label: Solving the relaxed knapsack
subgoals: Sort the items by value per unit of weight
Take whole items in that order while they fit
Fill the remaining budget with a fraction of the next item

label: The integer optimum
subgoals: List the subsets that fit within the budget
Pick the most valuable feasible subset
Confirm the integer value does not exceed the relaxed bound

label: Integrality gap and formulation strength
subgoals: Subtract the integer optimum from the relaxed optimum
Predict branch-and-bound effort from the size of the gap
Tighten the formulation when the gap is large
